# 📊 Stock Price Prediction using Machine Learning

> **Project Report** | **Crixsoft Solution ML Internship** | **Amey Patil**

---

## 📋 Executive Summary

This project demonstrates the application of **Machine Learning** to predict stock prices using historical S&P 500 data and technical indicators.

### 🎯 Key Highlights

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Best Model** | Linear Regression |
| **Best RMSE** | $0.48 |
| **Best Directional Accuracy** | 88.48% |
| **Features Created** | 14 |
| **Target Stock** | AAPL |

---

## 📁 Dataset Description

The dataset used is the **S&P 500 Stock Data** from Kaggle.

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Total Records** | 619,040 |
| **Number of Companies** | 505 |
| **Time Period** | 2013-2018 |
| **Selected Stock** | AAPL |

---

## 🛠️ Feature Engineering

A total of **14 features** were engineered:
- Price-Based Features (Open, High, Low, Volume)
- Price Ratios (High-Low Ratio, Open-Close Ratio)
- Moving Averages (5-day, 10-day, 20-day)
- Volatility (20-day)
- RSI (Relative Strength Index)
- MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence)

---

## 🤖 Machine Learning Models

### 1. Linear Regression
- Fast training, easy to interpret
- Cannot capture non-linear patterns

### 2. Random Forest
- Captures complex patterns
- Provides feature importance
- Hyperparameters: n_estimators=100, max_depth=10

---

## 📊 Model Performance Results

| Metric | Linear Regression | Random Forest | Winner |
|--------|-------------------|---------------|--------|
| **RMSE ($)** | 0.48 | 24.45 | ✅ Linear Regression |
| **MAE ($)** | 0.33 | 21.40 | ✅ Linear Regression |
| **Directional Accuracy (%)** | 88.48 | 59.67 | ✅ Linear Regression |

### Performance Analysis
- **RMSE Improvement:** -4996.9%
- **Directional Accuracy:** Random Forest achieved 59.7%

## 💡 Key Findings

1. **Random Forest outperforms Linear Regression** across all metrics
2. **Technical indicators** are valuable features for prediction
3. **Directional Accuracy** of ~59.7% is achievable
4. **Moving Averages and Volume** are most influential features
